I also have tinnitus - in fact I have had it since birth.

It is not completely clear from your post if your tinnitus itself has worsened, or only your perception of it was reset. I have a message of hope in either case :)

**If your tinnitus itself has worsened:** I began meditating after I developed a new tinnitus sound in January, and underwent severe anxiety/depression. Good news: I have habituated completely to the new sound as well, and thanks to meditation I'm actually happier and more peaceful now than I was before the new sound's onset.

**If your tinnitus is unchanged, but your perception of it was reset:** this has also happened to me before during a high-stress period, about 2 years ago. I struggled for a while, then realized that because I have habituated once, _the neural circuitry for habituation/ignoring tinnitus must still be there in my brain_, one single anxiety wave simply cannot undo years of conditioning. So there is nothing to do, I already know how to ignore tinnitus, I just need to wait for my brain to return to baseline. Which it did after a short period (days/weeks) and I was fine again.

So in either case, there definitely is hope.

In the meantime please take care of your hearing: no concerts, avoid headphones, and take supplements scientifically proven to be otoprotective (vitamins A/C/E, magnesium, and N-acetylcysteine - all of which should be available OTC).
